root_cause: The tile() syntax function in libavcodec/cbs_apv_syntax_template.c trusted the tile_data_size value derived from the bitstream's tile_header without validating it against the number of bits actually remaining in the reader (get_bits_left) before calling skip_bits_long(). The write-direction code path had an analogous check (put_bytes_left), but the equivalent check was omitted for the read-direction path when the function was first written, allowing out-of-bounds tile data ranges to be accepted silently.
